name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Tanis Alderwood asks you for fresh cloth in the Undercity. His wife is falling apart, and he hopes a wrapping can hold her together until an apothecary is free.

sections.title: A Beggar's Plea
sections.body: Tanis says the apothecaries are occupied with the Dark Lady's business. He asks you to bring him linen so he can wrap his wife while they wait for help. Her condition is the matter at hand.

faq.answer: Tanis Alderwood, a beggar in the Undercity, asks you to help his wife.
Tanis says she is literally falling apart and needs a wrapping to hold her together.
Tanis says the apothecaries are occupied with the Dark Lady's business.
Tanis asks you to bring him fresh cloth so he can wrap his wife while they wait for the apothecaries.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
